name: CareHub
tagline: AI customer support and a shared inbox for business messaging
description: CareHub is an AI-powered customer communications platform for sales and support teams. It brings messages from WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and a website chat widget into a shared inbox, so staff can handle conversations across channels in one workspace. Its AI assistant uses business-provided knowledge to answer customer questions, while conversations can be handed over to a human team member when needed. Businesses can use CareHub to manage incoming enquiries and coordinate automated and staff replies without switching between separate messaging apps. CareHub is a paid subscription product with a free trial; it is not a permanently free service.
